transcript.en: Good morning, Doctor Smith speaking.
transcript.zh: 早上好，我是史密斯医生。

transcript.en: How can I help you?
transcript.zh: 请问可以帮到您吗？

transcript.en: Well, I’ve been getting headaches frequently, so I’d like to get some advice.
transcript.zh: 我经常头疼，所以我想看看医生。

transcript.en: Ok. Firstly, how did you hear about us?
transcript.zh: 好的。首先，请问您是怎么知道我们的？

transcript.en: My friend Mrs. Harris told me that you did some good work for her a couple of years ago.
transcript.zh: 我的朋友哈里斯夫人告诉我，几年前您治好了她。

transcript.en: Do you remember?
transcript.zh: 您还记得吗？

transcript.en: Oh, yes, I remember Mrs. Harris.
transcript.zh: 是的，我记得哈里斯夫人。

transcript.en: I appreciate her compliment.
transcript.zh: 感谢她的赞美。

transcript.en: So… tell me about your headaches.
transcript.zh: 所以……告诉我您头痛的症状吧。

transcript.en: The headaches usually last about a week, sometimes it is so severe that I can’t continue my work.
transcript.zh: 头痛通常持续一周左右，有时严重到我无法继续工作。

transcript.en: Could you tell me what is going wrong?
transcript.zh: 您能告诉我出了什么问题吗？

transcript.en: Sorry to hear that. We will have to look further into this.
transcript.zh: 很遗憾听到这个消息。我们需要进一步检查。

transcript.en: I want to know - did you have headaches before?
transcript.zh: 我想知道 - 您以前有过头痛吗？

transcript.en: No, I didn’t suffer headaches previously.
transcript.zh: 不，我以前没有头疼过。

transcript.en: I’ve just been having them recently, perhaps for three months or so.
transcript.zh: 我最近才头痛，大概三个月左右了吧。

transcript.en: I see, well, I suggest that you should have an optic examination first.
transcript.zh: 好的，我建议您先做个眼科检查。

transcript.en: Do you know where the local optic examination center is?
transcript.zh: 您知道当地的验光中心在哪里吗？

transcript.en: No, I haven’t been there before.
transcript.zh: 不知道，我以前没去过那里。

transcript.en: Would you please tell me how to get there?
transcript.zh: 你能告诉我怎么去那里吗？

transcript.en: Of course. From here, you go along Shore Lane.
transcript.zh: 当然。从这儿，沿着海岸路.

transcript.en: You will see some crossroads, but remember to take a turn on the third one, then go straight down Bridge Street, keep going and then turn left at the first traffic light.
transcript.zh: 你会看到一些十字路口，但记得在第三个十字路口转一下，然后沿着桥街直行，继续前行，然后在第一个红绿灯处左转。

transcript.en: It is right there.
transcript.zh: 它就在那里。

transcript.en: Got it.
transcript.zh: 知道了。

transcript.en: Now, what I’ll do is fill in a form with you to find out a little bit more about your medical history and so forth.
transcript.zh: 现在，我要做的是和您一起填写一张表格，更多了解您的病史，等等。

transcript.en: Okay thank you.
transcript.zh: 好的，谢谢。

transcript.en: So first of all, can I take your name?
transcript.zh: 那么首先，您的名字？

transcript.en: It’s Anu Bhatt.
transcript.zh: 我是阿努·巴特。

transcript.en: Could you spell it please?
transcript.zh: 能拼一下吗？

transcript.en: Yes. A-N-U…B-H-A double T.
transcript.zh: 好的。A-N-U…B-H-A-T-T.

transcript.en: And where do you live?
transcript.zh: 住在哪里？

transcript.en: Oh, I live in my parents’ house, on 21 Eagle Road, that’s E-A-G-L-E Road, London.
transcript.zh: 我住在我父母家，伦敦，鹰路21号，拼写是E-A-G-L-E。

transcript.en: Oh, I often go to London on weekends too, it’s a lovely city.
transcript.zh: 我周末常去伦敦，那是个漂亮的城市。

transcript.en: And what’s the postcode there?
transcript.zh: 邮编是多少呢？

transcript.en: AL2 1DY.
transcript.zh: AL2 1DY。

transcript.en: Now I need to know your family medical history.
transcript.zh: 现在我需要知道你的家族病史。

transcript.en: Have either of your parents had any medical problems?
transcript.zh: 你的父母有任何疾病问题吗？

transcript.en: Yes, my mother has shellfish allergies, while my dad doesn’t.
transcript.zh: 有，我妈妈对贝类过敏，而我爸爸没有。

transcript.en: Oh, right, both of my parents have had toothache for most of their lives.
transcript.zh: 哦对了，我爸妈牙疼了大半辈子。

transcript.en: Ok, thanks.
transcript.zh: 好的，谢谢。

transcript.en: There is one more thing I need to take care of.
transcript.zh: 还有一件事。

transcript.en: Have you had allergic reaction to any medicines before?
transcript.zh: 你以前有没有对任何药物过敏？

transcript.en: No, that hasn’t happened before.
transcript.zh: 不，没有发生过。

transcript.en: Okay, I’ll make a note of that.
transcript.zh: 好的，我记一下。

transcript.en: I will write ‘none’ here. I think we are finished here for now.
transcript.zh: 那我在这里写上“无”。已经填完了。

transcript.en: Thank you. See you later.
transcript.zh: 谢谢。回头见。

transcript.en: See you then.
transcript.zh: 到时见。
